race.title: race
race.blurb: Race alleen tegen de computer of tegen mensen op je netwerk, met een citaat, woorden, tegen de klok of zolang je het tempo bijhoudt.
help: Kies wat je racet: een citaat, een aantal woorden, een tijdsduur of aanhoudend, waarbij de laatste die tempo of nauwkeurigheid blijft houden wint.
Tegenstanders racen ongeveer op je recente snelheid: makkelijk iets langzamer, moeilijk iets sneller. Wie verkeerde letters laat staan betaalt één seconde per fout.
Alleen race je tegen twee computerrivalen en, zodra je een run in die modus hebt, tegen een ghost daarvan die je kunt kiezen. Op je netwerk typt iedereen dezelfde tekst op hetzelfde moment.
Race tegen een ghost racet tegen ghosts die je hebt opgeslagen, maximaal drie tegelijk, op hun eigen tekst.

strength.label: strength
strength.summary: typing accuracy determines word strength. 1 per letter, +1 for K V W Y, +2 for J Q X Z. on hard, close variants of recent words count for less.

getting-started.label: getting started
getting-started.summary: type words to load the spoon, then carry them to feed the creature.
highlights: type a word to load it onto the spoon
click and drag the spoon to the creature to serve
details: each word you serve restores time. longer words restore more.
keep the creature happy to stay alive; wrong targets or misses keep the food on the spoon.

mood.label: mood
mood.summary: the creature’s mood drops over time if it isn’t fed.

patience.label: patience
patience.summary: a timer counts down. serving a word that fits restores time.

creature-requests.label: creature requests
creature-requests.summary: the creature asks for a kind of word — match it to earn full time.
highlights: read the prompt above the creature
a matching word earns full time; a wrong one costs time
details: requests include: short or long words, words starting with a letter, or words containing certain letters.
stuck for a while, or missed twice? a word that fits shows faintly on the creature, worth half the time.

hard.text: prompts are more specific and less time is given.

prompts.label: prompts
prompts.summary: the creature shows what kind of word it wants.

hint.label: belly hint
hint.summary: after idling or two misses, a valid word appears faintly on the creature.

snack-mode.label: snack mode
snack-mode.summary: the creature eats any word — stronger words fill it up more, but it gets hungry faster.
highlights: any valid word feeds the creature
longer and more accurate words restore more time
details: there are no prompts: type whatever word you like.
the creature drains its patience faster than in fussy eater, so speed matters.

buffet.label: buffet service
buffet.summary: guests order several kinds of word. serve words to the table and they eat what fits.
highlights: guests arrive with orders of 1–3 word types
keep overall satisfaction above the red line
details: type a word and press space to put it on the table. guests eat what matches their orders.
a filled order pleases the guest and raises satisfaction. a guest who waits too long leaves upset.
nonsense words are tossed and hurt satisfaction. typos produce burnt dishes worth half.
dishes left on the table go stale and are wasted.

table.label: table
table.summary: served words go on a shared table. guests eat what matches.

satisfaction.label: satisfaction
satisfaction.summary: a 0–100 meter. if it falls to the floor line, the buffet closes.

orders.label: orders
orders.summary: each guest has 1–3 word-type requirements on their ticket.

stale.label: stale dishes
stale.summary: uncollected dishes go stale and hurt satisfaction.

serving.label: physical serving
serving.summary: load words onto the spoon and physically carry them to the creature to serve.
highlights: type a word to load it onto the spoon
click the spoon, drag it to the creature, and release to serve
details: matching words feed the creature and restore time; wrong words cost time.
drop outside the creature to keep the food and try again.
press escape to cancel the food on the spoon.

spoon.label: spoon
spoon.summary: a valid typed word loads the spoon. click and drag to serve.

targeting.label: targeting
targeting.summary: hover over the creature to highlight it, then release to deliver the food.

getting-started.label: getting started
getting-started.summary: type words to make bricks, aim at a section, and lay them to build and repair your castle.
highlights: type a word to make a brick
aim with the arrows or mouse, then press space to lay it
details: longer words make stronger bricks. typos make cracked ones.
the castle starts whole, with a calm to stock up before the first wave.
bricks appear in the stockpile; pick one with 1–9 or drag it with the mouse.

prompted.text: in special bricks mode, sections under attack need specific words. an off-spec brick loses most of its strength.

stockpile.label: stockpile
stockpile.summary: typed words become bricks waiting in the yard. pick one with a number key or use the newest.

quality.label: brick quality
quality.summary: solid, patched, cracked or rubble — depends on word length and typing accuracy.

cursor.label: aiming
cursor.summary: the cursor shows where the next brick will go. move it with arrows or click a section.

i2.action: pick a brick from the stockpile

surviving.label: surviving
surviving.summary: keep the gate and the keep standing. each wave loses heart and retreats when critical sections hold.
highlights: the gate and the keep are critical — losing the keep ends the game
repair damaged sections by laying bricks on them
details: castle sections have integrity that drops when enemies attack.
high average repair across the castle drains the wave’s resolve faster.
each wave retreats when its resolve reaches zero, or when all its enemies are destroyed.

hard.text: enemies arrive stronger and in larger numbers.

sections.label: castle sections
sections.summary: wall, tower, gate, keep and foundations. each has its own integrity.

integrity.label: integrity
integrity.summary: a section’s hit points. reaches zero and the section is breached.

resolve.label: wave resolve
resolve.summary: a meter showing how close the wave is to retreating.

waves.label: waves
waves.summary: enemies arrive in numbered waves, with calms in between.

fighting.label: fighting
highlights: shift+enter drops a brick on the targeted attacker
brutes ram, sappers chip, catapults lob boulders from a distance
details: a brick drop deals damage equal to the brick’s strength.
an enemy that isn’t crushed may be stunned for a moment.
catapults station at a distance: a dashed arc shows where one is aiming.

brute.label: brute
brute.summary: rams sections up close. tires after a set number of blows.

sapper.label: sapper
sapper.summary: chips at sections. wanders between targets.

stun.label: stun
stun.summary: a non-lethal brick drop may stun the attacker, halting it briefly.

drops.label: brick drops
drops.summary: drop a brick on an enemy to damage or crush it.

i1.action: aim at a section or enemy

powering-up.label: powering up
powering-up.summary: crushed enemies sometimes drop powerups. store them and switch them on when you need them.
highlights: catch a powerup when an enemy is crushed
activate with shift+1–3 or click a slot
details: up to three powerups can be stored. two can be active at once.
mortar makes brick drops hit harder. mason makes laid bricks count for more. oil stuns all enemies on the field. mend repairs the weakest critical section.

oil.label: oil
oil.summary: stuns all attackers on the field immediately.

mend.label: mend
mend.summary: restores integrity to the weakest gate or keep.

getting-started.label: getting started
getting-started.summary: steer the ship, type words to load the magazine, and fire to destroy enemies.
highlights: move with the mouse or arrow keys
type a word and press enter to fire
details: finished words load into the magazine. press enter to fire the chosen shot.
a word finished with enter fires it at once without loading first.
use ↑ ↓ or the scroll wheel to choose which magazine slot to fire.

prompted.text: in targeted mode, every enemy ship has a word requirement. non-matching shots bounce off.

movement.label: movement
movement.summary: the ship steers horizontally. move with the mouse or ← →.

magazine.label: magazine
magazine.summary: typed words fill the magazine. enter fires. ↑ ↓ choose a slot.

surviving.label: surviving
surviving.summary: avoid damage, clear jams, dodge asteroids, and use rescue ships to repair.
highlights: the ship has health — hits reduce it, and zero ends the game
type the word on a green rescue ship to repair
details: clean words never jam. typos might, and nonsense jams more often.
when jammed, type the word shown to clear it, or press backspace twice with nothing typed to scrap the shot.
don’t shoot rescue ships: a hit one heals less (not on easy).
asteroids are indestructible obstacles. big ones break into several pieces when shot.
drones lock on with a dashed line and dive straight down. steer away.
ships that get past the bottom do no harm.

easy.text: shooting a rescue ship doesn’t reduce its healing.

health.label: health
health.summary: the ship’s hit points. zero means game over.

jams.label: jams
jams.summary: a jammed gun can’t fire until cleared. typos and nonsense raise the jam risk.

asteroids.label: asteroids
asteroids.summary: rocks that can’t be destroyed. big ones split into pieces.

rescue.label: rescue ships
rescue.summary: green ships with a word. type it to repair the hull.

drones.label: drones
drones.summary: lock on and dive straight down. dodge the dive line.

jammer.label: jammer
jammer.summary: increases the chance of jams while alive.

i0.action: scrap the chosen shot (clears a jam)

fighting.label: fighting
fighting.summary: load the magazine, intercept missiles and fighters, and use the bomb to clear the field.
highlights: missiles carry a letter — type it with nothing typed to shoot them down
shift+enter detonates the bomb when charged
details: loading words charges the bomb meter. when full, shift+enter clears all missiles and damages every enemy.
high-quality loaded words charge the capacitor. alt+enter discharges a vertical piercing laser; overload at 100% shatters shielded ships.
space stations launch fighters that chase you. type a fighter’s letter to shoot it down.
landmines burst into shrapnel when shot, which hits everything nearby, including you.

prompted.text: in targeted mode, every ship has a word requirement that must be matched.

missiles.label: missiles
missiles.summary: carry a letter token. with nothing typed, type it to shoot them down instantly.

bomb.label: bomb
bomb.summary: charges as you load words. shift+enter detonates, clearing missiles and damaging enemies.

fighters.label: fighters
fighters.summary: small ships launched by stations. chase the player. type their letter to intercept.

stations.label: stations
stations.summary: large hubs that hover and spawn fighters.

landmines.label: landmines
landmines.summary: spiked mines. shrapnel on destruction hits everything nearby.

shields.label: shields
shields.summary: some ships have shields that only break to words matching a requirement.

powering-up.label: powering up
powering-up.summary: destroyed enemies drop powerups. catch them, store them, and switch them on.
highlights: catch a floating powerup to store it
activate with shift+1–3 or click a slot
details: up to three powerups can be stored. two kinds can be active at once; the same kind again stacks its timer.
double fire: each shot fires twice before being spent.
gatling: every letter typed fires an instant bolt.
shield: a barrier absorbs hits for the ship.
automaton: automatically picks the best shot for the biggest threat.
homing: fired words steer toward targets.

double.label: double
double.summary: shots fire twice before being spent.

gatling.label: gatling
gatling.summary: every letter typed fires an instant energy bolt.

automaton.label: automaton
automaton.summary: auto-selects the best shot for the worst threat.

homing.label: homing
homing.summary: fired words steer dynamically toward targets.

help: Point at a word or move with ← → (↑ ↓ by line); click it or press Enter if it’s wrong.
The word stays in place: fix it there (← → Home End move the caret, or click in it) and press Enter. Spelling, punctuation, capitals and spacing all count.
Shift+Enter gives up on a passage and moves to the next.
Finding and fixing are scored separately; flagging a correct word costs you.

getting-started.label: getting started
getting-started.summary: find the mistakes planted in a passage and put them right.
highlights: click a word or move with the arrow keys
press enter to flag a mistake, then type the fix
details: passages come from books in your library. each has several planted errors.
shift+enter gives up on a passage and moves to the next.
errors include spelling, punctuation, capitalisation, sound-alikes and letter slips.

errors.label: error types
errors.summary: spelling, punctuation, capitalisation, sound-alikes and letter slips.

finding-mistakes.label: finding mistakes
finding-mistakes.summary: scan the passage, select a word you think is wrong, and press enter to flag it.
highlights: click a word or use the arrow keys to select it
flagging a correct word costs you
details: move with ← → word by word, or ↑ ↓ line by line. click a word to jump; click away to clear.
finding and fixing are scored separately.
flagging a word that’s actually correct counts as a false flag and costs points.

selection.label: word selection
selection.summary: click or use the arrow keys to select a word. selecting is free; only enter flags.

false-flag.label: false flags
false-flag.summary: flagging a correct word costs points and (in endless mode) time.

correcting-mistakes.label: correcting mistakes
correcting-mistakes.summary: the flagged word stays in place. fix it there and press enter to commit the repair.
highlights: the word is edited directly in the passage
move the caret with arrow keys or click inside the word
details: use ← → to move the caret, home and end to jump. delete and backspace work as usual.
click inside the word to place the caret at a specific position.
you get two attempts. if both fail, the correct word is revealed.
press escape to cancel a repair without penalty.
click another word mid-fix and the fix waits, as you left it, for you to click back.

caret.label: caret editing
caret.summary: move the cursor inside the word to edit individual characters.

retries.label: repair attempts
retries.summary: two tries to fix a word. after two failures, the answer is shown.

cancel.label: cancel
cancel.summary: escape cancels a repair without penalty.

scoring.label: scoring
scoring.summary: finding and fixing are scored separately. timed mode has a fixed clock; endless tops up on repairs.
highlights: detection score: how many errors you found
repair score: how accurately you fixed them
details: timed mode: a fixed duration counts down. find and fix as many as you can.
endless mode: time drains continuously. each successful repair tops up the bank. false flags cost time.
a clean sweep is recorded when all errors in a passage are repaired with no false flags.

hard.text: errors are subtler and the timer is shorter.

detection.label: detection
detection.summary: scored by precision and recall — how many real errors you found versus false flags.

repair.label: repair
repair.summary: scored by how accurately you fixed the flagged words.

sweep.label: clean sweep
sweep.summary: all errors repaired, no false flags, on a single passage.
